# AVKit

**Symbols:** 41.7% of Apple's iOS API (141 of 338, exact) · **Rows:** 9: 5 ✅ 1 🟡 3 ❌ · **iOS:** 8.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Media](../COVERAGE.md#media) · **Apple:** [AVKit](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avkit) · **Issues:** [`area:media`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Amedia)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** player controls drawn by isim, a Picture in Picture shell window, and a simulated AirPlay route picker.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| AVKit `AVPlayerViewController` | ✅ | ≤17 | iOS 17-style controls (play/pause, ±10 s, scrubber, elapsed/remaining, mute, close when presented, auto-hide), Picture in Picture, AirPlay (route picker) and playback-speed menu, delegate (PiP start/stop/restore, automatic dismissal); no info panels (`customInfoViewControllers`) or interstitials; tested (HelloVideo) |
| SwiftUI `VideoPlayer` (with `videoOverlay`) | ✅ | ≤17 | the overlay does not take touches |
| Picture in Picture (`AVPictureInPictureController`), `AVRoutePickerView` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: on a booted device the shell floats the video in a corner window over apps and the home screen, with close / restore / skip / play-pause controls (ids `pip-*`, scriptable); `isPictureInPicturePossible`, automatic start from inline, delegate (restore user interface); with `isim run` the window is drawn in the app; the route picker is the AirPlay card (iPhone, headphones when plugged in, an AirPlay speaker whose sound still comes from the host); tested (HelloVideo: inline, system window over the home screen, controls, restore). Missing: the video-call `ContentSource` |
| `AVPictureInPictureController.ContentSource(sampleBufferDisplayLayer:playbackDelegate:)`, `AVPictureInPictureSampleBufferPlaybackDelegate`, `invalidatePlaybackState()` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the layer's frames float in a window over the app (the system's window plays URLs, so not over the home screen); its play / pause, skip and close controls call the playback delegate, which also tells the play button's state; the delegate hears the window's render size; the layer shows iOS's placeholder meanwhile; tested (HelloSampleBuffers, test_sample_buffers) |
| Capture events: `AVCaptureEventInteraction` (`init(handler:)`, `init(primary:secondary:)`, `isEnabled`; iOS 26 `defaultCaptureSoundDisabled`), `AVCaptureEvent` (`phase`; iOS 26 `shouldPlaySound`, `play(_:)`), `AVCaptureEventPhase`, iOS 26 `AVCaptureEventSound` (`cameraShutter`, `beginVideoRecording`, `endVideoRecording`, `init(url:)`), SwiftUI `onCameraCaptureEvent` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted (`onCameraCaptureEvent`: 18.0): while an interaction is enabled in a view on screen and a capture session runs, the volume buttons (the bezel's, or `volume up\|down`) and the Camera Control (`cameracontrol press\|down\|up`, the bezel's button on the iPhone 16 / 17 / Air) send it began and ended events instead of changing the volume, like iOS; volume down and the Camera Control are primary, volume up secondary; without a running session the buttons change the volume; sounds are the system sounds (1108, 1117, 1118) or the file; tested (HelloCapture: test_capture_camera_control_and_mattes, test_capture_events_swiftui_and_directions) |
| iOS 27.1 `AVCaptureDeviceDirectionCoordinator`, `AVCaptureDeviceDirectionMap`, `AVCaptureDeviceDescriptor` | ✅ | 27.1 | adapted: the back cameras face forward and the front cameras backward (a device on its own: the map does not change, so the change handler is not called); tested (HelloCapture under iOS 27.1) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AVInterstitialTimeRange`, `AVKitError`, `AVKitError.Code`, `AVPictureInPictureVideoCallViewController` (4 types left; the capture event types are in isim since #382; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AVDisplayDynamicRange`, `AVInputPickerInteraction`, `AVLegibleMediaOptionsMenuController`, `AVLegibleMediaOptionsMenuState` (4 types left; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceContentArtwork`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceContentMetadata`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceContentURLArtwork`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceControllable`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceMediaSelectionControllable`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceMediaSelectionOption`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceMetadataProviding`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfacePlaybackControllable`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfacePlaybackPosition`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfacePlaybackState`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceSeekCapabilities`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceTimeControllable`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceTimelineSegment`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceTimelineSegmentType`, `AVPlaybackUserInterfaceVolumeControllable` (15 types left; the device direction types are in isim since #382; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
